narrative.intro: Ameresco obligated $56.4M in federal contracts in FY2027 to date, from 4 awards that average $14.1M each. Obligations fell 81.8% year over year. Fiscal-year trends show a peak in FY25 at $541M and a decline to $309M in FY26 before the current-year total of $56.4M. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the sole buying agency listed for FY2027 to date, accounting for the full $56.4M. Historical annual obligations include $122M in FY22, $107M in FY23, and $75.8M in FY24, illustrating substantial year-to-year variation in federal spending on Ameresco.
